CustomField.description: Controls the start date calculation logic for Gift Aid declarations. Set to 'Rolling 4 Years' to calculate exact dates 4 years prior to the declaration date, or 'Tax Years' to align start dates with the UK tax year calendar (April 6th).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select 'Rolling 4 Years' to calculate the start date exactly 4 years prior to the Declaration Date. Select 'Tax Years' to align the start date with the UK tax year calendar (April 6th).
CustomField.label: Start Date Calculation Rule
